foundation.framingA.title: Lolu ngumhlangano wethu wokuqala.
foundation.framingA.body:
Imibuzo emisiwe eyisikhombisa — kodwa ungama emva kwemibuzo emithathu ubone ukufunda kwakho kokuqala.

Azikho izimpendulo ezilungile. Ukwethembeka kungcono kunokuhlaba umxhwele.

Lona akuwona umhlahlo. Isithombe sokuqala salapho ukhona khona manje, ukuze ngikuhlangabeze khona lapho.
foundation.framingB.title: Lesi yisisekelo sakho.
foundation.framingB.body:
Lokho osanda kunginika kona kuba iqembu lakho lokuqala.

Einsukwini ezizayo ngizohlala ngilungisa kabusha — lona akuwona umhlahlo, isithombe sokuqala.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Yeqa phambili — bonisa ukufunda kwami manje
foundation.q1.title: Yimaphi kulamaqhinga agqamile kuwe manje?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Kufika ku-3. Yiba othembekile.
foundation.q1.opt4: Ukukhathazeka — ukwesaba okufanayo, indaba efanayo, ifindo elifanayo
foundation.q1.opt5: Ukujabulisa abantu — ngeke ngikwazi ukuthi cha
foundation.q2.title: Isivinini sokuzilolonga ongakwazi ukusigcina manje?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Akuyona imfuno. Lokho impilo yakho yamanje ezokunika khona.
foundation.q2.opt1: Okuthambile — umcimbi owodwa omncane, ongagcinwa phakade
foundation.q2.opt2: Okulingene — ukuzilolonga kwansuku zonke, amandla alinganiselwe
foundation.q2.opt4: Isigwili — ngifuna ingxenye enkulu yosuku ngaphakathi kwalokhu
foundation.q3.title: Uma uphupha ngobunjalo bakho obuhle kakhulu, banjani...
foundation.q3.opt4: Ohlakaniphile — uthule, ucacile, abanye baye kubo
foundation.q3.opt5: Phakathi kwemihlaba — ebona lokho abanye abangeke bakubone
foundation.q4.title: Yimuphi umnyango oseduze nawe manje?
foundation.q4.opt6: Umsebenzi wamandla — ukuphefumula, indlela yangaphakathi, ukuphila
foundation.q5.title: Yini ozoyicabangela kabusha lapha?
foundation.q6.title: Yikuphi okubonakala kuyiqiniso kakhulu?
foundation.q7.title: Uma kwenzeka okuthile okunzima, uya kuphi kuqala?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Qaphela ukunyakaza kokuqala.
foundation.q8.title: Ujwayelene kangakanani nokubuka imicabango yakho?
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Lokhu kuzoshintsha njengoba uzijwayeza. Akukho kulokho okulungisiwe — yinhloso yonke leyo.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Sizofunda lokhu kabusha njalo ezinsukwini ezimbalwa. Amabhendi ayahamba. Yinhloso yonke leyo.
foundation.brain.head.label: Okuholwa yikhanda
foundation.brain.heart.label: Okuholwa yinhliziyo
foundation.brain.gut.label: Kukula nge-gut
foundation.brain.head.line: Ucabanga kuqala. Sizokuhlonipha lokho, bese sifundisa umzimba ukuba uhambisane nakho.
foundation.brain.heart.line: UZwa kuqala. Sizokugcina lokho kuvulekile, bese sengeza ubufakazi ngemuva kwalokho.
foundation.brain.gut.line: Uhamba kuqala. Sizokwehlisa ijubane ngokwanele ukuze uzwe okungaphansi.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Ungabuya njalo ekufundeni kwakho emva kwesikhathi kusuka kuzilungiselelo. Akukho lutho oluphakade.
foundation.paths.title: Khetha abangane bakho.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Ukubuka kuyisisekelo — yonke indlela iqala lapho. Khetha izindlela ezi-2–3 ezizwakala ziphilayo kakhulu kuwe manje. Ungangeza ezinye kamuva.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Ukubukela okukhona, ngaphandle kokubamba noma ukucindezela. Yonke indlela esihamba ngayo ndawonye iqala kulesi sihlalo.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Le yindawo yakho yokuqala — ayisiyo intolongo. Indlela yakho izakuguquka njengoko usenza.
foundation.archetype.creator: Umdali
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Umsebenzi wamandla ngomoya kanye nendlela yangaphakathi.
